```{r example-data, include=FALSE}
# Same data as the Site KRI Report example, plus flag changes since the previous
# snapshot so the Overview and Sites tabs can show new and escalated flags.
library(gsm.core)
library(gsm.kri)

## Retired metric: inactive, with results in earlier snapshots only.
## The example data have none, so one is copied from the Adverse Event Rate.
dfMetrics <- gsm.core::reportingMetrics %>%
  dplyr::filter(MetricID == "Analysis_kri0001") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    MetricID = "Analysis_kri9999",
    Metric = "Retired Metric",
    Abbreviation = "RET",
    Active = FALSE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(gsm.core::reportingMetrics, .)
dfResults <- gsm.core::reportingResults %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    MetricID == "Analysis_kri0001",
    SnapshotDate < max(SnapshotDate)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(MetricID = "Analysis_kri9999") %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(gsm.core::reportingResults, .)

lCharts <- gsm.kri::MakeCharts(
  dfResults = dfResults,
  dfGroups = gsm.core::reportingGroups,
  dfMetrics = dfMetrics,
  dfBounds = gsm.core::reportingBounds
)

dfResultsDelta <- dfResults %>%
  FilterByLatestSnapshotDate() %>%
  gsm.reporting::CalculateChange(dfResults)
```

```{r example-report, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
## Render the v2 template inline. Outside this example, use:
## Report_KRI(..., strInputPath = system.file("report", "Report_KRI_v2.Rmd", package = "gsm.kri"))
child_env <- list2env(
  list(
    params = list(
      lCharts = lCharts,
      dfResults = dfResultsDelta,
      dfGroups = gsm.core::reportingGroups,
      dfMetrics = dfMetrics
    )
  ),
  parent = environment()
)
report_kri <- knitr::knit_child(
  system.file("report", "Report_KRI_v2.Rmd", package = "gsm.kri"),
  envir = child_env,
  quiet = TRUE
)
cat(report_kri, sep = "\n")
```
